answer_1.quote: We introduce Character-level Understanding of Tokens Evaluation (CUTE), a benchmark consisting of several tasks designed to be easy for humans to complete, given our ability to process characters individually.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text for tasks such as spelling words, writing words from spelled characters, character/word insertion, deletion, substitution, swapping, and similarity judgments.
